profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Ledgebrook
profile.geoLocationName: Wake Forest, North Carolina, United States
profile.summary:
Innovative and highly detailed professional, with broad knowledge and hands-on experience designing, developing, and enhancing company Web sites. Able to apply advanced technical expertise to improve operations, streamline procedures, and produce a powerful Internet presence. Personable individual, with a capacity to work well independently or with diverse teams.  Flexible, patient, and dedicated to meeting company needs, and exceeding expectations.

Technical Proficiencies:

Languages
HTML 4.0+, XHTML 1.0, PHP 4.0+, Cascading Style Sheets, Visual Basic, JavaScript, basic knowledge of Java, Freemarker Templates, SQL

XML
XML, XML Schemas, XML Notepad, DTD, XSL

Other
Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Access, Outlook), Microsoft Project, Visual Studio, Front Page Express, Active X Control Pad, Apache Web Server, Dreamweaver MX, Flash MX, Fireworks MX, MySQL Database, Oracle PL/SQL, PostgriSQL Database, MSSQL Database, XAMPP

Standards
Section 508 §1194.22 (a) – (p), W3C Web Standards, HIPAA

Specialties: •	Web Development and Coding
•	Project Planning and Leadership
•	Software Design, Development and Enhancement
•	Building and Sustaining Web Presence
•	Troubleshooting and Problem Resolution
•	Creating Algorithms and Program Designs

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer and Team Lead
Senior Software Engineer and Team Lead
Engineer
positions.description: Build and maintain the company website while building tools to empower the Marketing and CV teams to manage their workflows.  In addition, create and maintain a content management system using Joomla as a base.

positions.title: Associate Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Served on the Services development team, building and maintaining Candidate Page products for multiple customers.  Established myself as the go-to guy for HTML, CSS, Javascript and 508 compliance questions.

positions.title: IT Support/Web Development
positions.description: Ensure the success of the company Web site and Internet presence while driving the performance, functionality, and enhancement of systems, desktops, and equipment. Research new Web technologies, and write, test, and implement new on-line material. Maintain company software systems. Coordinate with Marketing, Quality Assurance, and other teams to resolve technical problems and spearhead Internet efforts. Analyze data from field personnel and prepare detailed reports.
